detail.placeholder: Click a day to see its files.
detail.emptyVault: No Markdown files in this vault yet.

settings.activitySourceDesc: Which timestamp counts as activity for a given day. Combined dedupes when created and modified fall on the same day.
settings.modifiedDateDesc: Which date counts as a note's last change, in the calendar and the heatmap. The updated property suits vaults where a plugin keeps it current; file time is the last write on this device.
settings.colorPaletteDesc: Color scheme for active cells. Auto follows your Obsidian theme's interactive-accent color; named palettes use their own hues.
settings.customHexDesc: Hex color like #39d353. Used when color palette is set to custom.
settings.windowLengthDesc: How many days the heatmap spans. Shorter ranges give a narrower grid with finer detail.
settings.weekStartDesc: First day of the week in the grid.
settings.excludeFoldersDesc: Comma-separated list of folder paths to skip when counting activity. Matches by prefix, so Archive skips Archive/notes but not My-Archive/notes.
settings.includeTagsDesc: Comma-separated list of tags. If set, only files with at least one of these tags count. Leave empty to include all files. Leading # is optional.
settings.showCalendarDesc: Month calendar with a dot for each note created or modified that day.
settings.showHeatmapDesc: Activity heatmap with its pager, sparkline and legend.
settings.lastSectionDesc: At least one of the calendar and the heatmap stays visible.
settings.showSparklineDesc: 30-day compact bar chart above the legend.
settings.showStreakCounterDesc: Flame and trophy milestones in the detail panel header.
settings.showMiniStatsDesc: Week / month / year file counts under the streak row.
settings.showStatusBarDesc: Display your current streak and today's file count in Obsidian's status bar. Click it to open the pane.
